spec_match.rationale: Walks document.styleSheets recursively and reads the exact CSSImportRule members (href, media, layerName, supportsText, styleSheet) the CSSOM interface defines, including the nullable read this feature changes.

interactive.rationale: Six toggleable test imports (plain, print media, layer(), false supports, 404, nested chain) plus a walk button rebuild the live table; auto-walks on load so the page is never empty.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a recursive walk including the cross-origin Google Fonts SecurityError edge; the table delivers those exact rows.

edge_cases.rationale: Cross-origin cssRules SecurityError handled per sheet, failed 404 import row, never-fetched false-supports row, layered and media-gated imports, nested import chain with depth indentation.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5123480866783232 and the CSSOM interface section.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite covers the walked contracts (rule retention, null states, SameObject, supportsText); the inspector's cross-origin and failure rows mirror the suite's honest fails on 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: toggled four imports, walked 10 sheets / 5 import rules / 1 blocked cross-origin (real Google Fonts import), clean console, no failed requests on load, 0px overflow both classes, screenshots read. Partial: on 141 no row reads null (141 wrongly fetches parenthesized-false imports), so the nullable rendering of that cell is pinned by the conformance suite rather than browser-observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the walk completes with sheets and import rules found, recording sheet/import/null/blocked counts; console output is intentional per-walk summaries.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; aria-pressed toggles invert background AND color together; emerald/rose/amber cell colors sit on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Toggle buttons expose aria-pressed state, table has caption + th scopes, scrollable wrapper is a labelled tabindex=0 region, single polite output announces walk results.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table lives in an overflow-auto wrapper with sticky headers (responsive-table guidance), so the page itself never overflows at 360px; harness reports 0px overflow and clean console on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Re-walk on a Chrome 158 build to show null rows live
openQuestions.detail: On this 141 container the false-supports row shows a wrongly-fetched non-null sheet and the 404 row a phantom empty sheet. On 158+ both should render the red 'null' cell; verify and capture that state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with thead/th scopes inside an overflow-auto wrapper; sticky headers keep context while scrolling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table uses caption, scoped headers, position:sticky thead, and a .table-wrapper with overflow:auto and max-inline-size:100%, so horizontal scroll stays inside the labelled region and the page never overflows at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible toggle buttons with pressed state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with aria-pressed for binary toggles and keep the pressed style change non-color-only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Test-import toggles are native buttons with aria-pressed, inverting background and text colour together (invariant 6) so the state change is both announced and high-contrast.

summary: Recursive CSSOM import-tree inspector with real cross-origin, layered, media-gated, failing and conditional rows. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): 10 sheets / 5 imports / 1 SecurityError-blocked sheet walked with clean console and 0px overflow on both classes.
